chosen.text: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.

candidates.text: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.
candidates.context: Paul writing to the church at Colossae, describing the shared life of believers in Christ.
candidates.whyItFits: Songs are meant to carry the word of Christ and teach the congregation, which is exactly what lyric-checking tools aim to protect; it also stresses wisdom and mutual teaching, not outsourced judgment.

candidates.text: Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good. Abstain from every form of evil.
candidates.context: Paul to the young church in Thessalonica, closing exhortations about weighing prophetic and spiritual teaching.
candidates.whyItFits: Fits the discernment and testing theme, and the call to hold fast to what is good, though it is less about song.

candidates.text: Sing to him a new song. Play skillfully with a shout of joy!
candidates.context: A psalm of praise calling Israel's worshippers to sing to the LORD.
candidates.whyItFits: Celebrates crafted, skillful worship music, but says little about theological content.
